description: Allocate 2D arrays in Java and use nested for loops with mat2.length and mat2[i].length to print every element row by row.
source: draft: agy free model + edit: codex

steps.description: Allocate mat1 as a 10-by-10 int[][] array and initialize mat2 with the 2-by-2 literal { { 1, 0 }, { 0, 1 } }.
Use an outer loop over row index i up to mat2.length and an inner loop over column index j up to mat2[i].length to print mat2[i][j].

steps.answer: For i = 0, j steps through 0 and 1 to print mat2[0][0] (1) and mat2[0][1] (0). For i = 1, j steps through 0 and 1 to print mat2[1][0] (0) and mat2[1][1] (1).
steps.question: In what order do the nested loops visit the elements of mat2 = { { 1, 0 }, { 0, 1 } }?

steps.description: Watch the inner loop print mat2[0][0] = 1 on its first iteration when i = 0 and j = 0.

title: Creating and Traversing a 2D Array in Java
